children: NioCorp Developments Ltd reported a net loss attributable to the company of $(48.6)M for fiscal 2026, versus a loss of $(17.4)M in fiscal 2025. The company recorded no revenue in either year and reported loss per share (basic and diluted) of $(0.41) for FY2026 compared with $(0.36) for FY2025.
Revenue was $0 for FY2026 and $0 for FY2025 (no revenues from mining operations during the periods presented).
Net income: Net loss attributable to the Company of $(48.6)M for FY2026, compared with $(17.4)M for FY2025 (increase in loss driven by higher operating and non‑cash fair value expenses).
Diluted EPS: Loss per share (basic and diluted) of $(0.41) for FY2026, versus $(0.36) for FY2025.
Project advancement: Completed 2025 drilling, commenced mine portal excavation and finished the 2026 Elk Creek Study supporting updated reserve estimates.
Operational focus: Prioritizing detailed engineering, procurement, and early construction activities while deferring full construction until project financing is secured.
Product expansion: Redesigned processing plan to target eight critical mineral products (up from three), increasing capital and operational scope.
Cash runway & spend plan: Cash supports approximately 12 months of planned $65–$75M outflows for project advancement, portal work, and corporate overhead.
Government & export support: Actively pursuing EXIM, UK and German export credit support and Department of the Interior reimbursements to de‑risk project financing.
